button.name: action_llm_score_all
button.invisible: state in ('draft', 'cancelled') or not active or not awaiting_scoring_count or scoring_phase == 'stopping'

button.name: action_kill_scoring
button.confirm: Stop subjective grading for this assessment? Any answer already scored keeps its mark - only the remaining model calls are cancelled. Any individual re-score still waiting on this paper is DROPPED and will have to be asked for again. You can run scoring again afterwards.

button.name: action_llm_score_failed
button.confirm: Re-queue only the candidates whose subjective grading failed or errored. Answers already scored keep their marks and are not re-graded or re-billed. Continue?
button.invisible: state in ('draft', 'cancelled') or not active or not scoring_failed_count or scoring_phase == 'stopping'

button.name: action_cancel
button.confirm: Cancel this assessment? Invited candidates will no longer be able to take it.

button.name: action_reset_draft
button.confirm: Reset to Draft permanently deletes every candidate's attempt and answers for this assessment, including results already released to candidates. The candidate list is kept. This cannot be undone. Continue?

sheet.div: Subjective grading is queued but nothing is grading it. A scoring cron is inactive or more than 15 minutes overdue, or a grading lane has stored nothing in 15 minutes (a held lane lock, the daily spend cap, or every call failing); the console's grader banner names which. An inactive cron is re-enabled under Settings > Technical > Scheduled Actions ("Assessments BE v2: Auto-score"). Nothing queued is lost while it waits, but a lane whose calls keep failing may still be making, and billing, them.

field.name: question_limit
field.help: Number of questions to pick from the generator. 0 = all questions.

field.name: duration_minutes
field.help: Time limit in minutes. At least 2 - every assessment is timed.

sheet.div: The exam is never ended automatically. On Violation is set to Log only, so violations are recorded and listed. Reaching the Violation Limit only marks the attempt "Violation limit breached", for you and for the candidate; a Violation Limit of 0 means no limit. Set On Violation to auto-submit to end the exam at the Violation Limit - it is marked "Violation limit breached" too.

field.name: raw_result
field.help: Sum of raw points over EVERY component: each contributes its ungated quality as a 0-1 fraction - a keyed sub-question its own mark, a written answer the grader's number, a labelling one the mean of its box raws. Same denominator as the mark beside it. Marks threshold this per COMPONENT to 0/1, so a low raw total can still show 0 marks.

button.name: action_release_results
button.confirm: Release results for the selected candidates? Each of them sees their marks at once. This cannot be undone - once released, there is no way to take them back.

button.name: action_rescore_individually
button.invisible: state != 'submitted' or unresolved_answer_count == 0 or results_released or assessment_scoring_phase == 'stopping'

button.name: action_rescore_individually
button.confirm: This candidate's results have already been RELEASED - they can see these marks. Re-scoring costs one model call per answer and can change a mark they are looking at. An answer keeps its old mark if the new grade fails. Continue?
button.invisible: state != 'submitted' or unresolved_answer_count == 0 or not results_released or assessment_scoring_phase == 'stopping'

button.name: action_release_results
button.confirm: Release this candidate's results? They see their marks at once. This cannot be undone - once released, there is no way to take them back.

button.name: action_erase_candidate_data
button.confirm: Anonymize this candidate's free-text answers, violation reason, and grader audit prose? Numeric scores and pass/fail are kept. This cannot be undone.
